description: This source file defines the LocationCurrentRequest enum with functions for resolving current location, handling location accuracy, and managing cache expiration within a location service module.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the current location, utilizing cache if valid, or requesting a new fix with specified parameters.

methods.name: accuracyValue
methods.description: Converts a custom accuracy enum to CoreLocation's CLLocationAccuracy constant.
